device_entry.description: 一种基于文件的项目持久化存储组件，用于在实验数据工作流中保存项目属性、数据项关系以及相关数据文件路径，支持实验项目的数据组织、读取与长期归档。
device_entry.description_en: A file-based project persistence component used in laboratory data workflows to store project properties, data-item relationships, and related data file paths, supporting experiment data organization, loading, and long-term archiving.
